items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They had but one or two records, “Jumpin’ The Blues” by Jay McShann... Jay McShann. ... came through there.

ctx.x: By this time, were you listening more regularly to records...
Well, they didn’t have many records. They had but one or two records, “Jumpin’ The Blues” by Jay McShann...
